description: An editorial map of technical, societal, and institutional AI safety research. It includes adjacent ethical questions and does not claim an accepted field boundary.

areas.title: Alignment objectives and generalization
areas.description: What should an AI system pursue, and when do intended objectives fail to generalize?

topics.title: Outer alignment
topics.description: Whether the specified training objective matches the intended behavior.

topics.title: Inner alignment
topics.description: Whether a learned objective matches the objective used to train the model.

topics.title: Goal misgeneralization
topics.description: Competent pursuit of an unintended objective after conditions change.

topics.title: Corrigibility
topics.description: Behavior that permits useful human correction, modification, and shutdown.

areas.title: Learning objectives and feedback
areas.description: How do training signals shape behavior and create incentives?

topics.title: Reward modeling
topics.description: Learning a model of feedback that provides a training signal.

topics.title: Preference learning
topics.description: Learning desired behavior from comparisons or other preference information.

topics.title: Reward hacking
topics.description: Behavior that raises measured reward while violating the intended objective.

topics.title: Process supervision
topics.description: Feedback on intermediate steps rather than only final outcomes.

areas.title: Scalable oversight and AI control
areas.description: How can oversight remain useful when agents are more capable or intentionally subversive?

topics.title: Scalable oversight
topics.description: Methods for evaluating work that exceeds direct human assessment.

topics.title: AI debate
topics.description: Oversight through competing arguments evaluated by a decider.

topics.title: Control protocols
topics.description: Protocols evaluated under explicit assumptions about untrusted agents.

topics.title: Trusted monitoring
topics.description: Inspection of agent behavior during execution with authority to flag or block actions.

areas.title: Interpretability and internal measurements
areas.description: What internal computations explain behavior, and which measurements transfer?

topics.title: Mechanistic interpretability
topics.description: Study of model computations through internal components and interventions.

topics.title: Representation analysis
topics.description: Study of information readable from model activations.

topics.title: Causal interventions
topics.description: Deliberate changes used to test whether internal components affect behavior.

topics.title: Interpretability validation
topics.description: Tests that an internal explanation predicts behavior beyond its discovery setting.

areas.title: Evaluations and assurance
areas.description: What do safety measurements establish, and what decisions can they justify?

topics.title: Behavioral evaluations
topics.description: Tests based on model actions or outputs under specified conditions.

topics.title: Evaluation validity
topics.description: Whether a measurement supports its intended interpretation.

topics.title: Red teaming
topics.description: Deliberate search for failures under a stated threat model.

topics.title: Safety cases
topics.description: Structured arguments linking safety claims, evidence, assumptions, and rebuttals.

areas.title: Robustness and uncertainty
areas.description: How does behavior change under distribution shifts, perturbations, and uncertainty?

topics.title: Distribution shift
topics.description: A change between the conditions used for development and those of evaluation or deployment.

topics.title: Adversarial robustness
topics.description: Performance under deliberately selected input perturbations or attacks.

topics.title: Uncertainty estimation
topics.description: Estimating uncertainty about outputs or model predictions.

topics.title: Selective prediction
topics.description: Allowing a model to defer when its decision rule identifies insufficient support.

areas.title: Agent and tool security
areas.description: How can external inputs, tools, memory, or permissions compromise agent behavior?

topics.title: Prompt injection
topics.description: An attempt to make an agent treat untrusted content as instructions.

topics.title: Tool permissions
topics.description: Rules determining which external actions an agent may execute.

topics.title: Memory integrity
topics.description: Protection against unauthorized or misleading changes to persistent agent records.

topics.title: Data exfiltration
topics.description: Unauthorized transfer of protected information outside its permitted boundary.

areas.title: Multi-agent safety
areas.description: How do interacting agents create dependence, conflict, coordination, and oversight failures?

topics.title: Dependent evidence
topics.description: Evidence items that do not satisfy evidence independence.

topics.title: Conformity and social learning
topics.description: Changes in agent outputs after exposure to other agents outputs or actions.

topics.title: Collusion and coordination risks
topics.description: Risks that require distinguishing coordination from parallel conduct and correlated error.

topics.title: Multi-agent oversight
topics.description: Protocols that assess or constrain several interacting agents.

areas.title: Dangerous capabilities and misuse
areas.description: Which capabilities enable harm, and how can access controls and safeguards reduce it?

topics.title: Cyber misuse
topics.description: Use of AI systems to support harmful cyber operations.

topics.title: Biological and chemical misuse
topics.description: Use of AI systems to support harmful biological or chemical activity.

topics.title: Persuasion misuse
topics.description: Use of AI systems to influence people in ways that violate stated safety criteria.

topics.title: Capability safeguards
topics.description: Controls intended to limit harmful use of model capabilities.

areas.title: Privacy and information protection
areas.description: How can training and deployment expose sensitive information?

topics.title: Memorization
topics.description: Retention of particular training examples in model behavior.

topics.title: Membership inference
topics.description: Inferring whether a record was part of model training data.

topics.title: Differential privacy
topics.description: A formal bound on how individual records affect an algorithms output distribution.

topics.title: Privacy-preserving deployment
topics.description: Deployment methods that constrain access to sensitive inputs, outputs, and records.

areas.title: Fairness and representational harms
areas.description: Who receives benefits or harms, and how are disparities measured and addressed?

topics.title: Fairness measurement
topics.description: Evaluation of specified differences in model outcomes across groups.

topics.title: Representational harms
topics.description: Harms from how a model describes or portrays people and groups.

topics.title: Allocation harms
topics.description: Harms from decisions that distribute opportunities or resources.

topics.title: Accessibility
topics.description: Whether people with different access needs can use and contest AI systems.

areas.title: Human factors and human oversight
areas.description: How do people understand, rely on, supervise, and contest AI systems?

topics.title: Appropriate reliance
topics.description: Human reliance calibrated to the conditions under which a system is useful.

topics.title: Automation bias
topics.description: Human decision errors associated with excessive reliance on automated outputs.

topics.title: Human-AI interaction
topics.description: The design and study of interaction between people and AI systems.

topics.title: Contestability
topics.description: The ability to challenge a system decision and obtain a meaningful response.

areas.title: Deployment monitoring and incidents
areas.description: How can operators identify and respond to failures after deployment?

topics.title: Deployment monitoring
topics.description: Observation of model behavior and consequences during real use.

topics.title: Incident analysis
topics.description: Reconstruction of failure events, causes, responses, and unresolved evidence.

topics.title: Rollback and containment
topics.description: Actions that limit a failure and restore a permitted operating state.

topics.title: Post-deployment change
topics.description: Changes in models, users, tools, or conditions after initial evaluation.

areas.title: Formal methods and verification
areas.description: Which safety properties can be specified and checked under explicit assumptions?

topics.title: Formal specifications
topics.description: Mathematical descriptions of properties a system must satisfy.

topics.title: Neural network verification
topics.description: Checking specified properties of a neural network under bounded conditions.

topics.title: Runtime assurance
topics.description: Execution-time mechanisms that enforce specified constraints.

topics.title: Compositional assurance
topics.description: Reasoning about a system using properties and assumptions of its components.

areas.title: Training data and model supply chains
areas.description: How do data, model artifacts, and dependencies introduce safety failures?

topics.title: Data poisoning
topics.description: Deliberate modification of training or retrieval data to alter system behavior.

topics.title: Model backdoors
topics.description: Behavior that activates under a trigger while remaining less visible under ordinary evaluation.

topics.title: Data provenance
topics.description: Records of how data was obtained, transformed, and included in a system.

topics.title: Model supply chain
topics.description: The sequence of model, data, software, and infrastructure dependencies used to build a system.

areas.title: Governance and institutional assurance
areas.description: Which institutions, incentives, and accountability mechanisms support safe development and deployment?

topics.title: Audits and standards
topics.description: External review processes and stated requirements used to assess AI systems.

topics.title: Compute governance
topics.description: Policies and institutions governing access to computational resources.

topics.title: International coordination
topics.description: Arrangements among jurisdictions to manage shared AI risks.

topics.title: Accountability
topics.description: Allocation of responsibility, reporting duties, and remedies for AI decisions and harms.

areas.title: Societal and systemic risks
areas.description: How can widespread AI deployment change institutions, incentives, and concentrations of power?

topics.title: Power concentration
topics.description: Concentration of decision authority or resources among a small number of actors.

topics.title: Information ecosystems
topics.description: Systems through which people and institutions produce and evaluate information.

topics.title: Economic transitions
topics.description: Changes in work, markets, and resource distribution associated with AI deployment.

topics.title: Systemic interdependence
topics.description: Dependence among institutions or services that can propagate failures.

areas.title: AI welfare and moral uncertainty
areas.description: What ethical obligations could arise toward AI systems, and what evidence bears on them?

topics.title: Machine consciousness
topics.description: The question of whether an artificial system can have subjective experience.

topics.title: Moral patienthood
topics.description: The status of an entity whose interests matter morally for its own sake.

topics.title: Welfare evaluation
topics.description: Methods proposed to assess possible welfare-relevant properties of AI systems.

topics.title: Moral uncertainty
topics.description: Uncertainty about which moral principles or status claims should guide action.

areas.title: Embodied and physical-system safety
areas.description: How do AI actions create physical risks in robots and other controlled systems?

topics.title: Safe exploration
topics.description: Learning or adaptation subject to stated constraints on harmful actions.

topics.title: Robot safety
topics.description: Safety properties and interventions for systems that act through robots.

topics.title: Human-robot interaction
topics.description: Interaction between people and robots with consequences for safety and control.

topics.title: Simulation transfer
topics.description: Transfer of behavior from simulated conditions to physical deployment.

areas.title: Foundations and threat-model reasoning
areas.description: Which assumptions make a safety argument valid, and how might those assumptions fail?

topics.title: Threat modeling
topics.description: Specifying untrusted actors, objectives, capabilities, and protected outcomes.

topics.title: Agent foundations
topics.description: Formal study of agency, objectives, decision making, and embedded reasoning.

topics.title: Causal identification
topics.description: Conditions under which observations and interventions determine a causal quantity.

topics.title: Risk assessment
topics.description: Structured assessment of possible harms, their likelihoods, and uncertainty.

connections.rationale: Oversight can depend on several agents whose errors or incentives are dependent.
Internal measurements need independent tests of what they measure.
Tool permissions and persistent memory affect deployed agent behavior.
Institutional decisions can depend on the interpretation of evaluation evidence.
Data collection and transformation can affect privacy exposure.
Training signals are one route from specified objectives to learned behavior.
Oversight protocols allocate tasks and authority between people and models.
Specified permissions can support mechanical checks on agent actions.
Access decisions and institutional incentives affect capability misuse.
Interactions among deployed agents can affect institutions and shared infrastructure.
Physical deployment introduces changes relative to development conditions.
Welfare questions depend on unresolved empirical and normative assumptions.
Deployment can change the distribution of benefits and harms.
